listing.name: Rockstar Games Presents Table Tennis — Table Tennis Recomp (bartando)
listing.summary: Upstream reaches match on Apple Silicon and PS5, LAN crossplay tested. Timing acceleration, shader stutter and rally correctness remain; Windows less tested. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Xbox360 ISO incl default.xex, no title update. Title545407DF. Exact supported hash/revision not captured.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Release Windows ZIP/macOS DMG/native PS5 package observed. Setup extracts user ISO. macOS Apple Silicon Vulkan/MoltenVK; Windows x64 Vulkan AVX2.

warnings: Upstream reaches match on Apple Silicon and PS5, LAN crossplay tested. Timing acceleration, shader stutter and rally correctness remain; Windows less tested.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
